briefdescription.para: Phase-3 extended plan-cache and cost-model utilities for the graph module.

detaileddescription.para:
Provides:
themis::graph::GraphLRUPlanCache – thread-safe, generic LRU cache with TTL
themis::graph::GraphCostHistogram – fixed-bucket latency histogram
themis::graph::GraphAdvancedCostModel – extended per-algorithm cost model
